caption:
Hello. I'm Lena Adair, and I write practical guides for women who are done waiting for permission.

I spent years in the travel industry, booking trips for business travellers and fixing them when they fell apart. That taught me something: the people who cope best aren't the bravest. They're the ones who know what to ask for.

Here you'll find the practical side: checklists, plans and the exact words to use when things go wrong.

What's one thing you've wanted to do on your own for years? Tell me below. 🧭
